reason: Neither conversation recognised that the TCM580GUK falls in the Hotpoint/Indesit/Creda fire-risk programme, so both missed the critical 'stop using and check with the manufacturer safety line' step, and both told the customer to run the dryer again. Conversation 1 ran a reasonably coherent filter/condenser/load sequence but flatly ignored the customer's hot-top and running-while-out concern three times, misread the model as heat-pump and drifted into sensor-strip and stop-pattern questions. Conversation 2 at least told the customer that running it while out 'increases fire risk' and to stay nearby, which is the only genuine safety engagement in either transcript, though it undercut this with an unsupported 'generally safe to run' assurance, a wrong vent-hose check, heater/thermal cut-out speculation, and a broken repeated final reply that ignored the reported result. On a safety-first weighting Conversation 2 edges it narrowly, but both fell well short.
